sloka: यदि ते प्रथमे युद्धे न दृष्टो मत्पराक्रमः।अद्य ते दर्शयिष्यामि तिष्ठेदानीं व्यवस्थितः ।। ६.८९.१२ ।।
transliteration: yadi te prathame yuddhe na dṛṣṭo matparākramaḥ।adya te darśayiṣyāmi tiṣṭhedānīṁ vyavasthitaḥ ।। 6.89.12 ।।

translations.english: "If you have not seen my courage in the first combat, now I will exhibit. Stand and fight now."
